job.job_description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Backend Developer to build scalable backend services that support AI/ML applications. The role involves developing data ingestion pipelines, APIs, storage solutions, and cloud deployments to enable production-ready AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python (FastAPI/Flask).
Build data ingestion, transformation, and ETL pipelines.
Integrate AI/ML models with enterprise applications.
Design and manage SQL, NoSQL, and Vector databases.
Deploy and monitor applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Implement logging, monitoring, CI/CD, and performance optimization.
Collaborate with AI Engineers and Frontend Developers to deliver end-to-end AI solutions.

Required Skills

3-6 years of experience in Python backend development.
Strong knowledge of FastAPI/Flask, REST APIs, and SQL.
Experience with ETL pipelines, data integration, and databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker, and Git.
Exposure to AI/ML deployments, LangChain, RAG, or Vector Databases is a plus.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Kubernetes, Airflow, CI/CD, or MLOps.
Knowledge of LLM integration and cloud-based AI deployments.
